messages.subject: zero infected Poisson spatiotemporal model
parts:
Dear Prof;

I am working zero infected Poisson spatiotemporal model on RINlA unfortunately after 3 and half days I got the following errors;

 Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :

  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.

  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

 

With Regards;

Anteneh

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] zero infected Poisson spatiotemporal model
parts:
hi & thanks for your email. It's almost surely an issue about lack of
memory. Also, run with verbose=TRUE and check if there are other issues
as well, like INF or NAN values. You can set some options to minimize
memory, like

control.inla = list(int.strategy = "eb", strategy = "adaptive")

and limit the number of threads,

num.threads=2

say
